ucs.title: [LLM] APT41 (Wicked Panda / Brass Typhoon) IIS post-exploitation: w3wp.exe spawning LOLBins after webshell drop
ucs.description: Hunts APT41's signature IIS exploitation chain — exploit of a public-facing app (Citrix NetScaler, ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus, Confluence, Log4Shell, MOVEit), webshell drop under wwwroot/inetpub by w3wp.exe, then hands-on-keyboard discovery via LOLBins. Correlates the file-drop and the process-tree pivot on the same host within a short window so single-event noise is suppressed.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_id) as child_pid from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")) NOT Processes.user="*$" by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| join host [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as webshell_time values(Filesystem.file_path) as webshell_path values(Filesystem.file_name) as webshell_name values(Filesystem.file_hash) as webshell_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.asmx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.cshtml" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.jsp" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.jspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.war") (Filesystem.file_path="*\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\inetpub\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\webapps\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\TomEE\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ADSelfService\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ManageEngine\\*") by host
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
  ]
| eval delta_sec=firstTime-webshell_time
| where delta_sec >= -3600 AND delta_sec <= 21600
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ctime(webshell_time)
| table firstTime host user parent_process_name process_name cmds child_pid webshell_time webshell_path webshell_name webshell_hash delta_sec
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let WebshellWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx" or FileName endswith ".asmx"
         or FileName endswith ".cshtml" or FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName endswith ".jspx"
         or FileName endswith ".war" or FileName endswith ".asp"
    | extend FolderLower = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where FolderLower has_any (@"\wwwroot\", @"\inetpub\", @"\webapps\", @"\tomee\", @"\manageengine\", @"\adselfservice\")
    | project WebshellTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              WebshellPath = FolderPath, WebshellName = FileName, WebshellHash = SHA256;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner WebshellWrites on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between ((WebshellTime - 1h) .. (WebshellTime + 6h))   // 1h pre-drop to 6h post-drop — APT41 typically pivots within a shift
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, WebshellTime)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          WebshellName, WebshellPath, WebshellHash, WebshellTime, DelaySec,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","tasklist.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","wmic.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let WebshellWrites = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName endswith "w3wp.exe"
    | where TargetFileExtension in~ ("aspx","ashx","asmx","cshtml","jsp","jspx","war","asp")
    | extend PathLower = tolower(TargetFilePath)
    | where PathLower has_any (@"\wwwroot\", @"\inetpub\", @"\webapps\", @"\manageengine\")
    | project WebshellTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, WebshellPath = TargetFilePath, WebshellName = TargetFileName, WebshellHash = TargetFileSHA256;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName), NewProcessShort = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentLower endswith "w3wp.exe"
| where NewProcessShort in~ (SuspiciousChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner WebshellWrites on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between ((WebshellTime - 1h) .. (WebshellTime + 6h))
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, WebshellTime)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = AccountName, ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, WebshellName, WebshellPath, WebshellHash, WebshellTime, DelaySec
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT41 IIS Worker Process (w3wp.exe) Spawns Discovery LOLBin
id: 7c1f6e2c-d8a7-4e2a-9c41-1a8b7f2d9101
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the IIS worker process w3wp.exe spawning command-line interpreters or discovery
  LOLBins, a characteristic hands-on-keyboard pattern observed in APT41 / Wicked Panda /
  Brass Typhoon post-exploitation after the actor drops an ASPX/JSP webshell (e.g.
  Behinder/Antsword/Godzilla) on Citrix NetScaler, ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus,
  Confluence, MOVEit, and other public-facing apps.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096/
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/apt41-us-state-governments
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/apt41-arisen-from-dust
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\tasklist.exe'
      - '\systeminfo.exe'
      - '\quser.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and not filter_machine_account
fields:
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate diagnostic actions by site administrators via custom IIS handlers
  - Vendor-supplied management consoles invoking shell helpers from the IIS app pool
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1082
  - attack.g0096

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^w3wp\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|certutil|bitsadmin|cscript|wscript|whoami|nltest|wmic|rundll32|regsvr32|tasklist|systeminfo|net1?|quser|ipconfig)\.exe$/i

| join(query={#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(wwwroot|inetpub|webapps|manageengine|adselfservice)\\.*\.(aspx|ashx|asmx|cshtml|jsp|jspx|war|asp)$/i ContextImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i | rename(field="TargetFileName", as="WebshellPath") | rename(field="@timestamp", as="WebshellTime")}, field=[aid], include=[WebshellPath, WebshellTime])

ucs.rationale: APT41 is one of the most prolific abusers of public-facing IIS / Java app servers — Mandiant, NSA/CISA AA22-138B, and Google TAG attribute the bulk of mid-2020s government and telecom intrusions to APT41 chaining T1190 → webshell (Antsword / Behinder / Godzilla / China Chopper variants) → w3wp.exe-hosted reconnaissance. The detection's strength is the *combination*: a webshell-extension file writt

ucs.title: [LLM] APT41 DUSTTRAP / DodgeBox DLL side-loading: legitimately-signed third-party binary relocated to a writable path with same-folder DLL load an
ucs.description: Hunts APT41's signature loader chain (DUSTPAN/DUSTTRAP 2024, DodgeBox 2024, ShadowPad/PlugX for years prior) — a legitimately-signed non-Microsoft binary (Vivaldi updater, IObit, JustSystems, Bandai Namco signed components, Symantec, Anti-virus helpers) executing from %ProgramData% / %Public% / %Temp% / %PerfLogs%, side-loading a same-folder DLL, then beaconing to a public IP within ten minutes. The triple correlation (path + sideload + C2) uniquely fingerprints APT41 vs generic crimeware sideloaders.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as proc_time values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as proc_hash values(Processes.process_company) as vendor values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*") Processes.process_signature_verified=true NOT Processes.process_company="Microsoft*" NOT Processes.process_path="*\\WindowsApps\\*" NOT Processes.process_path="*\\Packages\\*" NOT Processes.user="*$" by host Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| rename process_id as pid, process_path as signed_image
| eval signed_folder=replace(signed_image, "\\\\[^\\\\]+$", "")
| join host pid [
    | tstats summariesonly=true values(Filesystem.file_path) as dll_path values(Filesystem.file_name) as dll_name values(Filesystem.file_hash) as dll_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" (Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*") by host Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.action
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
    | rename process_id as pid
  ]
| eval dll_folder=replace(dll_path, "\\\\[^\\\\]+$", "")
| where signed_folder==dll_folder
| join host pid [
    | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as conn_time values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category="public" by host All_Traffic.process_id
    | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
    | rename process_id as pid
  ]
| eval delta_sec=conn_time-proc_time
| where delta_sec>=0 AND delta_sec<=600
| convert ctime(proc_time) ctime(conn_time)
| table host user proc_name signed_image vendor proc_hash dll_path dll_name dll_hash remote_ip remote_port proc_time conn_time delta_sec
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WritablePaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
let MisplacedSignedBinaries = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where isnotempty(ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName)
    | where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !startswith "Microsoft"
    | extend FolderLower = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where FolderLower has_any (WritablePaths)
    | where FolderLower !contains @"\windowsapps\" and FolderLower !contains @"\packages\" and FolderLower !contains @"\winsxs\"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend ProcFolder = tolower(strcat(tostring(split(FolderPath, "\\")[0])))   // unused — kept for join debug
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId,
              SignedImage = FolderPath, SignedFolder = FolderLower, SignedHash = SHA256,
              Vendor = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, Product = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
              ProcCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let SideloadedDlls = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | extend DllFolderLower = tolower(FolderPath)
    | where DllFolderLower has_any (WritablePaths)
    | where DllFolderLower !contains @"\windowsapps\" and DllFolderLower !contains @"\packages\"
    | project DllTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, DllPath = FolderPath, DllName = FileName, DllHash = SHA256, DllFolderLower;
let C2 = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where Protocol in~ ("Tcp","Udp")
    | project ConnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl;
MisplacedSignedBinaries
| join kind=inner SideloadedDlls on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where DllFolderLower == SignedFolder        // DLL sits in the SAME folder as the relocated signed binary — APT41 signature
| join kind=inner C2 on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where ConnTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 10m)   // 10m post-spawn — DodgeBox/DUSTTRAP beacon timing
| project ProcTime, DeviceName, AccountName, Vendor, Product,
          SignedImage, SignedHash, ProcCmd,
          ParentName, ParentCmd,
          DllPath, DllName, DllHash, DllTime,
          ConnTime, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WritablePaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\appdata\local\temp\", @"\appdata\roaming\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\"]);
let Procs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | extend ImageLower = tolower(ActingProcessName)
    | where ImageLower has_any (WritablePaths)
    | where ImageLower !contains @"\windowsapps\" and ImageLower !contains @"\packages\"
    | where isnotempty(ActingProcessFileCompany) and ActingProcessFileCompany !startswith "Microsoft"
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | extend SignedFolder = tolower(strcat_array(array_slice(split(ActingProcessName, "\\"), 0, -2), "\\"))
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessId,
              SignedImage = ActingProcessName, SignedFolder, SignedHash = SHA256,
              Vendor = ActingProcessFileCompany, Product = ActingProcessFileProduct,
              ProcCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = ParentProcessName, ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine;
let Net = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr) == false
    | where DstIpAddr !startswith "127." and DstIpAddr !startswith "::1"
    | project ConnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, ConnDirection = NetworkDirection;
Procs
| join kind=inner Net on DvcHostname
| where ConnTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + 10m)
| project ProcTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, Vendor, Product,
          SignedImage, SignedHash, ProcCmd, ParentName, ParentCmd,
          ConnTime, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\PROGRAMDATA\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\appdata\local\temp\* OR *\AppData\Roaming\* OR *\appdata\roaming\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\windows\temp\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\perflogs\*) -@Image:(*\WindowsApps\* OR *\windowsapps\* OR *\Packages\* OR *\WinSxS\*) @Company:* -@Company:Microsoft* -@Company:"Microsoft Corporation" -@Company:"Microsoft Windows" -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(programdata|users\\public|appdata\\local\\temp|appdata\\roaming|windows\\temp|perflogs)\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(windowsapps|packages|winsxs)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ImageFileName=/\.exe$/i
| signed_proc_path := ImageFileName
| signed_pid := TargetProcessId
| join(query={#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4) NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4) NOT cidr("127.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) NOT cidr("169.254.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4)}, field=[aid], key=[aid], include=[ContextProcessId, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort, ContextImageFileName])
| ContextProcessId=signed_pid
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, signed_proc_path, CommandLine, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading is widespread, but APT41 has a tightly characterised variant documented across multiple Mandiant reports (DUSTPAN/DUSTTRAP July 2024, DodgeBox/MoonWalk July 2024, earlier ShadowPad/PlugX deployments) and CISA AA22-138B: the actor copies a *legitimately signed third-party* binary (Vivaldi browser updater, IObit Uninstaller, JustSystems, Bandai Namco, AhnLab helpers, AV-vendor tools
